name: Sandman
summary: A stealthy spell-thief who combines performance, deception, trapcraft, and precise magical attacks.

features.name: Stealspell
features.summary: Use a touch attack and performance to temporarily steal a prepared or known spell and cast it with your own available slots.

features.name: Slumber Song
features.summary: Cause a creature already fascinated by your performance to fall asleep without a Hit Dice limit.

features.name: Dramatic Subtext
features.summary: After performing for two rounds, conceal the visual and audible components of your spellcasting unless observers beat your Sleight of Hand with Perception.

features.name: Greater Stealspell
features.summary: Learn a failed target's spells and spell resistance, choose the spell stolen, or transfer half your Bard level of spell resistance.

features.name: Mass Slumber Song
features.summary: Use Slumber Song against any number of fascinated creatures within 30 feet.

features.name: Spell Catching
features.summary: When you save against a spell targeting only you, spend performance rounds to absorb it and immediately recast it or another spell of that level or lower.
features.uses: bardic performance rounds equal to spell level

features.name: Master of Deception
features.summary: Add half Bard level to Bluff, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth, and use Disable Device against magical traps.

features.name: Sneakspell +1 DC
features.summary: Increase spell and performance save DCs against opponents denied their Dexterity bonus.

features.name: Sneakspell +2 vs. Spell Resistance
features.summary: Gain a bonus on caster-level checks against denied-Dexterity opponents.

features.name: Trap Sense +1
features.summary: Gain a bonus on Reflex saves and a dodge bonus to AC against traps.

features.name: Sneak Attack +1d6
features.summary: Deal precision damage to nearby targets you flank or that are denied their Dexterity bonus.
